stories.title: Tote und Vermisste nach Fährunglück in Indonesien

en.title: Deaths and missing after ferry accident in Indonesia
en.summary: A ferry carrying over 240 people sank in Indonesia, with six deaths confirmed and many passengers still missing. Search and rescue operations continue in rough sea conditions.

en.title: Söder on chancellor overthrow speculation: "Definitely not from the CSU"
en.summary: CSU party leader Söder rejected speculation about a potential change of federal chancellor, stating the CSU will not remove Chancellor Merz.

en.title: Borussia Mönchengladbach Parts Ways with Coach Eugen Polanski
en.summary: Borussia Mönchengladbach has ended its relationship with coach Eugen Polanski one day after losing 0-5 to Freiburg in response to a poor season start.

en.title: Borussia Mönchengladbach: Parting Ways with Coach Eugen Polanski Following 0-5 Defeat
en.summary: Borussia Mönchengladbach has separated from coach Eugen Polanski after suffering a catastrophic 0-5 loss against Freiburg.

stories.title: Nach punktlosem Start: Gladbach trennt sich von Trainer Polanski

en.title: After Winless Start: Gladbach Parts Ways with Coach Polanski
en.summary: Borussia Mönchengladbach has made the first coaching change of the Bundesliga season, separating from its head coach after just three matches, matching last year's pattern.

stories.title: Bilger drängt auf Wiedereinführung der Familienreservierung bei der Bahn

en.title: Bilger pushes for reintroduction of family seating reservation at German railways
en.summary: Family seating reservations on German trains became more expensive in June 2025. Transport Minister Bilger is now calling for the reintroduction of this cheaper booking option.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Söder: CSU wird Kanzler Merz „auf keinen Fall“ stürzen

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Söder: CSU will "definitely not" overthrow Chancellor Merz
en.summary: Following a CDU electoral defeat in Saxony-Anhalt, CSU leader Söder clearly dismisses speculation about a possible change in the federal chancellor.

stories.title: US Open: Aryna Sabalenka zertrümmert ihren Schläger und weint, Jelena Rybakina lächelt höflich

en.title: US Open: Aryna Sabalenka smashes her racket and cries, Jelena Rybakina smiles politely
en.summary: Kazakhstani Jelena Rybakina became the world's top-ranked tennis player. In the US Open final, her opponent Aryna Sabalenka displayed intense emotions while Rybakina demonstrated her championship class.

stories.title: Indonesien: Viele Vermisste nach Fährunglück vor der Küste

en.title: Indonesia: Many Missing After Ferry Accident Off Coast
en.summary: A deep-sea ferry carrying over 240 people capsized off Indonesia. Rescue crews have recovered 103 passengers so far, with rough seas hampering search and rescue operations.

stories.title: Kleinwagen: Mehr als 30.000 Bestellungen für E-Polo von VW

en.title: Small Car: More than 30,000 Orders for VW's E-Polo
en.summary: The VW ID. Polo has received over 30,000 pre-orders, demonstrating demand for affordable German electric vehicles. Volkswagen plans to increase production at its Spanish facility.

stories.title: US Open: Rybakina feiert Grand-Slam-Triumph gegen Sabalenka

en.title: US Open: Rybakina Celebrates Grand Slam Victory Against Sabalenka
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open in New York, ending Aryna Sabalenka's title streak. Rybakina is now the new world number one.

stories.title: Gastkommentar: Europas Banken brauchen einfachere Regeln, keine laxeren

en.title: Guest commentary: Europe's banks need simpler rules, not looser ones
en.summary: European banking stability supports the continent's competitiveness. According to ECB supervisory officials, banks require risk-appropriate regulations and reduced unnecessary administrative burden.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Litauen schließt Flughafen Vilnius wegen mutmaßlicher Drohne

en.title: Ukraine war: Lithuania closes Vilnius airport due to suspected drone
en.summary: Lithuania has shut down Vilnius airport following a suspected drone incident. The closure occurs amid ongoing developments in the Ukraine conflict, including reports of attacks and diplomatic discussions.

en.title: Federal government: CDU officials rebel: "A CDU chancellor must provide direction and solve problems"
en.summary: Growing dissatisfaction with the chancellor is emerging as some CDU parliamentarians publicly oppose him, calling for new momentum and more substance in policy.

stories.title: Kommentar: Die größte KI-Gefahr ist nicht die Superintelligenz

en.title: Commentary: The greatest AI danger is not superintelligence
en.summary: While AI leaders issue dire warnings resembling science fiction, many risks already exist. The primary concern is that providers do insufficient work to prevent misuse.

en.title: The world in images: Eye-catcher
en.summary: Photographs capture various human experiences and moments, ranging from impressive and moving to fascinating and disturbing, documenting significant events and small wonders while telling stories about our world.
